about: Backlog for the daily product articles (2 per day, Sunday–Thursday). The scheduled task takes the first two topics with status 'planned' whose 'blockedBy' is empty, re-checks the keyword in Semrush (database qa) and the live blog for overlap, writes both languages, and sets status to 'published' with the date and file. Keyword volumes are monthly searches in Qatar from Semrush (qa), 16 Nov 2026. Topics already covered by live articles were left out on purpose; 'avoidOverlapWith' names live posts the new angle must not repeat.
source: Semrush keyword research, database qa, 16 Nov 2026 (handoff section 4-أ; skill bestolex-content-writer section 7)
